close_reason: The motivating seal runaway no longer exists, and a two-tier provisional-publication model would duplicate consistency ownership. fz-kdt.34 now owns the single generic concept: monotone current cells plus a quiescent group epoch for consumers requiring finality.
description:
Closed as a redundant consistency model.

The motivating seal runaway no longer exists. A provisional-publication tier and an explicit group-epoch object both duplicate concepts already present in current values, dependency readiness, and settled reads.

fz-kdt.44 owns the one remaining contract: settledness must be transitively sound, while readiness-only movement must not recalculate formulas whose input content is unchanged. No independent implementation remains here.
title: Folded: transitive settledness replaces provisional publication
